name: warden
description: Warden - encrypted, locally-hosted personal document vault. This root package.json is a coordinating layer only (via `concurrently`) - it does not replace server/package.json or client/package.json. See README.md.
_predevComment: npm runs 'predev' automatically before 'dev', with no separate step needed. A leftover Node process from a previous dev session (esp. on Windows, where a stopped npm run dev can leave node.exe behind - see README troubleshooting) has repeatedly held onto ports 5000/5173, causing either a hard EADDRINUSE crash on the backend or Vite silently bumping to 5174 (a port not in CORS_ORIGINS, so the frontend can't reach the API). Freeing both ports before every start makes 'npm run dev' reliable regardless of what happened last session.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --host"
